narrative.overview:
Noter should feel like a dependable notebook sitting on a quiet desk: immediate, familiar, private, and hard to disrupt. The system is restrained product UI, built around a scannable sidebar, a generous Writing Surface, contextual Markdown tools, compact footers, and warm accent states that appear only when they help the task.

The visual language rejects an Apple Notes clone, a developer Markdown workbench, a folder or notebook-heavy organiser, a command-palette-first productivity shell, and a cloud-sync product. It should not use hover-only actions, permanent status chrome, generic destructive confirmations, or decorative visual noise around the Note.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained palette with Warm Capture Yellow reserved for action, selection, focus, and progress.
Light surfaces read as paper neutrals; Dark Theme reads as Dim Desk Surfaces, not inverted colors.
Compact controls and stable 45px footers keep workflow chrome predictable.
Markdown affordances support writing without becoming the product frame.

rules.name: The One Warm Signal Rule
rules.body: Warm Capture Yellow is functional, not decorative. If it does not indicate action, selection, focus, highlight, or progress, remove it.

rules.name: The Separate Theme Rule
rules.body: Light and Dark Themes must be tuned separately for surfaces, borders, selection, Search Hint readability, and selected Note recognition.

rules.name: The Source Family Rule
rules.body: Use the local Source families for product UI and Markdown editing. Do not introduce display fonts, decorative letter spacing, or fluid type.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest do not need shadows. Add lift only when an element floats, interrupts, or temporarily overlays the task.

dos: Do keep Warm Capture Yellow rare and functional.
Do keep the Note Title, Note Metadata, Writing Surface, Preview, and View Mode Controls visually connected.
Do use compact 45px footers for sidebar utilities and editor View Mode Controls.
Do tune Light and Dark Themes separately for text, borders, selection, and overlay readability.
Do use full borders, tonal backgrounds, rings, and explicit labels for important states.
donts: Don't make Noter feel like an Apple Notes clone.
Don't make Noter feel like a developer Markdown workbench.
Don't introduce a folder or notebook-heavy organiser.
Don't turn Search into a command-palette-first productivity shell.
Don't imply cloud sync through persistent status chrome.
Don't hide Note Actions behind hover-only affordances.

Don't use persistent syntax instruction blocks, generic destructive confirmations, decorative chrome around the Writing Surface, gradient text, glassmorphism, colored side-stripe borders, or identical decorative card grids.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Warm primary action for creating the first Note or confirming an intentional action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #FFB340; color: #FDFDFC; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px/20px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.05); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #CA8A04; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFB340; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Soft filled Search field for finding Notes without turning Search into a command system.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35m1.1-5.15a6.25 6.25 0 1 1-12.5 0 6.25 6.25 0 0 1 12.5 0Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg><input placeholder="Search" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.05); color: #6B7280; padding: 6px 16px 6px 12px; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-search:hover, .ds-search:focus-within { background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.10); } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #111827; font: 400 14px/20px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search-hint { margin-top: 6px; border: 1px solid #D2D2D7; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; font: 500 11px/16px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Secondary Note Metadata chip for recognition and filtering.
components.css: .ds-tag-chip { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.05); color: #6B7280; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 12px/16px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tag-chip:hover { background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.10); color: #111827; } .ds-tag-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFB340; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Note Row
components.description: Scannable Note List row with selected state strong enough for Light and Dark themes.
components.css: .ds-note-row { width: 280px; display: grid; gap: 4px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #FFB340; border-radius: 0; background: rgba(255, 179, 64, 0.10); color: #111827; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 179, 64, 0.25); transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-note-row strong { font: 600 14px/20px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-note-row span { color: #6B7280; font: 400 12px/16px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-note-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFB340; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editor Footer Control
components.description: Compact segmented control used in the stable 45px editor-area footer.
components.css: .ds-footer { height: 45px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #D2D2D7; background: #FDFDFC; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-footer button { border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 6px; background: #FDFDFC; color: #6B7280; padding: 2px 6px; font: 500 11px/16px "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-footer button:hover { border-color: #D1D5DB; } .ds-footer button.is-active { border-color: #FFB340; background: rgba(255, 179, 64, 0.10); color: #FFB340; } .ds-footer button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFB340; outline-offset: 2px; }
